SELECT r.casenum, 
  (r.return_details->'shipping'->>'fee')::real as shipping_fee,
  (fm.cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'restocking_fee')::real as restocking_fee,
  (fm.cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'relabeling_cost')::real as relabeling_cost,
  (fm.cost_breakdown->'disposal'->>'disposal_cost')::real as disposal_cost,
  (fm.cost_breakdown->'repair_costs'->>'repair_estimate')::real as repair_estimate
FROM returns r
JOIN financial_management fm ON fm.casetag = r.casenum
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
  SUM(
    CASE WHEN p.product_traceability->'compliance'->>'regulatory_compliance' = 'Non-compliant' 
    THEN 0.2 * (
      (r.return_details->'shipping'->>'fee')::real +
      (fm.cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'restocking_fee')::real +
      (fm.cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'relabeling_cost')::real +
      COALESCE((fm.cost_breakdown->'disposal'->>'disposal_cost')::real, 0) +
      COALESCE((fm.cost_breakdown->'repair_costs'->>'repair_estimate')::real, 0)
    )
    ELSE 0 END
  ) as total_penalty
FROM returns r
JOIN financial_management fm ON fm.casetag = r.casenum
JOIN products p ON r.itemlink = p.itemcode;
SELECT COUNT(*) as non_compliant_count FROM returns r JOIN products p ON r.itemlink = p.itemcode WHERE p.product_traceability->'compliance'->>'regulatory_compliance' = 'Non-compliant';

  fm.cost_breakdown->'disposal'->>'disposal_method' as disposal_method,
  ROUND(CAST(SUM(
    CASE WHEN p.product_traceability->'compliance'->>'regulatory_compliance' = 'Non-compliant' 
    THEN 0.2 * (
      (r.return_details->'shipping'->>'fee')::real +
      (fm.cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'restocking_fee')::real +
      (fm.cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'relabeling_cost')::real +
      COALESCE((fm.cost_breakdown->'disposal'->>'disposal_cost')::real, 0) +
      COALESCE((fm.cost_breakdown->'repair_costs'->>'repair_estimate')::real, 0)
    )
    ELSE 0 END
  ) AS numeric), 2) as total_penalty
FROM returns r
JOIN financial_management fm ON fm.casetag = r.casenum
JOIN products p ON r.itemlink = p.itemcode
GROUP BY fm.cost_breakdown->'disposal'->>'disposal_method'
ORDER BY total_penalty DESC;
